name: HabitLens
shortDescription: A habit-tracking app with flexible habit types, customisation, and detailed progress statistics.
overview: HabitLens is a habit-tracking application designed to help users record habits and understand their progress over time.
objectives: Make habit tracking simple and customisable.
role: Designed and developed the application as a solo project.
features: Checkbox, numerical-goal, counter, and rating-based habits
